source.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; import yaml; d=yaml.safe_load(Path('.ai/roadmap-state.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); assert d['active_track']=='control-plane-closure'; assert d['active_track_status']=='COMPLETE'; assert sum(x.get('status')=='NEXT' for x in d['sequence'])==0; p=d['post_closure_human_priority']; assert p['id']=='downstream-control-plane-portability-policy'; assert p['status']=='AUTHORIZED'; assert p['task_id']=='TASK-114'; c=Path('docs/CHATGPT_PROJECT_CONTRACT.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); r=Path('docs/AIOS-ROADMAP.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'portable downstream' in c.lower(); assert 'explicit' in c.lower() and 'binding' in c.lower(); assert 'CHATGPT_PROJECT_CONTRACT_RECONCILIATION remain active downstream commitments' not in c; assert 'downstream-control-plane-portability-policy' in r"

claims.claim: The Project Contract preserves exact-pin downstream isolation and defines standard AIOS outer control-plane capability as portable downstream through explicit reviewed repository binding.
Policy separates capability availability from activation and grants no implicit workflows, permissions, bindings, or mutation authority.
Distinct lifecycle, Runtime, Reviewer, and Publisher authorities remain separated without introducing a generic lifecycle router.
The roadmap preserves historical Control-plane Closure completion, distinguishes TASK-109 history from current policy, and does not promote optional milestones.
Roadmap state remains COMPLETE with zero NEXT items and records the TASK-114 post-closure priority as AUTHORIZED with fresh downstream BRAIN SYNC requirements.
Stale downstream commitment language is absent and current governance requires fresh downstream synchronization.
Historical and frozen semantics remain unchanged; the bounded correction passed the unchanged deterministic verification and git diff check and was committed.
